data.comment:
# Comfy Grok- Text to Image

Input text prompts to generate high-quality images quickly using the Grok model. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_grok_text_to_image.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Cinematic portrait of a young beautiful Latina woman with dark hair and bangs, in a vibrant, neon-lit Japanese arcade at night. She looks back over her shoulder at the camera with an intense, captivating gaze. The scene is drenched in a dreamy, moody atmosphere. Her face is dramatically illuminated by the strong pink and magenta glow from a nearby arcade machine, casting soft shadows, while cool cyan neon light creates sharp highlights on her hair and the side of her face. The shot is taken through a glass panel, creating distorted, colorful neon light reflections and a sense of depth. Shallow depth of field blurs the background into a beautiful bokeh of orange and yellow lights. Light film grain, subtle film texture, detailed realistic skin texture, glossy lips, neon-noir aesthetic.
